description: List the policy packs the Decionis evaluator ships — finance, devops, sap, salesforce, workday, hospitality and the workflow overlays — with each pack's key, description, default decision domain and exact bundle version. Pass a key as policy_pack to decionis_evaluate to decide under that pack instead of the repository policy file. Entirely local: the catalogue is read from the in-process protocol, nothing is fetched.
name: decionis_list_policy_packs
title: List Decionis Policy Packs
